assertion.statement: In v2.0.0 the Crossplane core command no longer emits the startup log line "Composition Revisions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-revisions flag will be removed in a future release." — the deprecation warning for the --enable-composition-revisions flag (already a no-op since Composition Revisions are GA) was removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go.

proposal.undeterminedReason: consequence: The evidence shows only that the deprecation-warning log line was removed; it does not state whether the --enable-composition-revisions flag itself is still defined or accepted by the v2.0.0 core command, so what happens to a workload that still passes the flag cannot be determined.
